input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position: Vendor warrants the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel to industry standards (19.1), Deliverables conform to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days after delivery or acceptance (whichever is later) and hosted Services conform throughout the subscription term (19.2) — better than the 12-month/90-day preferred benchmark for a hosted model — plus no-malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance warranties (19.3). The remedy in 19.4 is re-performance, repair or replacement and, failing that, termination with refund of Fees paid, and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not limit the express warranties, service levels, indemnities or remedies, so it does not swallow the express warranty. No redline needed.
